name: HackTool - LaZagne Execution
description:
Detects the execution of the LaZagne. A utility used to retrieve multiple types of passwords stored on a local computer.
LaZagne has been leveraged multiple times by threat actors in order to dump credentials.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Some false positive is expected from tools with similar command line flags.
query: process.executable:*\\lazagne.exe OR ((process.executable:(*\:\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\:\\ProgramData\\* OR *\:\\Temp\\* OR *\:\\Tmp\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\AppData\\* OR *\\Downloads\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\*)) AND (process.command_line:(*.exe\ all OR *.exe\ browsers OR *.exe\ chats OR *.exe\ databases OR *.exe\ games OR *.exe\ git OR *.exe\ mails OR *.exe\ maven OR *.exe\ memory OR *.exe\ multimedia OR *.exe\ sysadmin OR *.exe\ unused OR *.exe\ wifi OR *.exe\ windows))) OR ((process.command_line:(*all\ * OR *browsers\ * OR *chats\ * OR *databases\ * OR *games\ * OR *git\ * OR *mails\ * OR *maven\ * OR *memory\ * OR *multimedia\ * OR *php\ * OR *svn\ * OR *sysadmin\ * OR *unused\ * OR *wifi\ * OR *windows\ *)) AND (process.command_line:(*\-oA* OR *\-oJ* OR *\-oN* OR *\-output* OR *\-password* OR *\-1Password* OR *\-apachedirectorystudio* OR *\-autologon* OR *\-ChromiumBased* OR *\-composer* OR *\-coreftp* OR *\-credfiles* OR *\-credman* OR *\-cyberduck* OR *\-dbvis* OR *\-EyeCon* OR *\-filezilla* OR *\-filezillaserver* OR *\-ftpnavigator* OR *\-galconfusion* OR *\-gitforwindows* OR *\-hashdump* OR *\-iisapppool* OR *\-IISCentralCertP* OR *\-kalypsomedia* OR *\-keepass* OR *\-keepassconfig* OR *\-lsa_secrets* OR *\-mavenrepositories* OR *\-memory_dump* OR *\-Mozilla* OR *\-mRemoteNG* OR *\-mscache* OR *\-opensshforwindows* OR *\-openvpn* OR *\-outlook* OR *\-pidgin* OR *\-postgresql* OR *\-psi\-im* OR *\-puttycm* OR *\-pypykatz* OR *\-Rclone* OR *\-rdpmanager* OR *\-robomongo* OR *\-roguestale* OR *\-skype* OR *\-SQLDeveloper* OR *\-squirrel* OR *\-tortoise* OR *\-turba* OR *\-UCBrowser* OR *\-unattended* OR *\-vault* OR *\-vaultfiles* OR *\-vnc* OR *\-windows* OR *\-winscp* OR *\-wsl*)))
